# Config reference

A pipeline document is a YAML file (or a Python dict) loaded with `Pipeline.from_config(...)` or `load_pipeline(...)`. Top-level pipeline document. List entries are `name` or `{name: params}`. Unknown top-level keys are rejected. `${NAME}` is replaced by the environment variable `NAME`.

## Top-level keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `normalize` | list of string or mapping | empty | List of normalizers applied in order. Each entry is a name or a one-key mapping `{name: params}`. |
| `blocking` | list of string or mapping | empty | List of blockers; their candidate pairs are unioned. |
| `compare` | mapping of mapping | empty | Mapping `feature -> {fn: comparator_or_string_function, ...params}`. Each entry produces column `f_<feature>`. |
| `score` | string or mapping or null | `null` | One scorer, a name or `{name: params}`. |
| `route` | string or mapping or null | `null` | One router, a name or `{name: params}`. |
| `validate` | list of string or mapping | empty | List of validators run on the pairs the router left for review. |
| `cluster` | string or mapping or null | `null` | One clusterer. |
| `consolidate` | string or mapping or null | `null` | One consolidator. |
| `hooks` | list of string or mapping | empty | List of hooks. |
| `options` | object (Options) | empty | Engine options. |

## `options` keys

| Key | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `legacy_score_feature` | string or null | `null` |
| `max_pairs` | integer | `50000000` |
| `undecided` | string | `"unvalidated"` |
| `random_state` | integer | `0` |

See the [component catalogue](components.md) for the names and parameters that each section accepts.
